blocks.title: Enthalpy change of combustion
blocks.text: Kisi substance ki standard enthalpy change of combustion woh enthalpy change hai jo tab hoti hai jab us substance ka ek mole zyada (excess) oxygen mein, standard conditions par, poori tarah jal jaye.
Yeh hamesha exothermic hoti hai (heat bahar nikalti hai). Misal: ethanol ki standard enthalpy of combustion ΔH°C = –1368 kJ mol⁻¹ hai.

blocks.text_alt: C₂H₅OH(l) + 3 O₂(g) → 2 CO₂(g) + 3 H₂O(l)    ΔH°C = –1368 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Enthalpy change of combustion se khane (foods) aur fuels ka calorie content nikala jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Methane (CH₄) ki standard enthalpy of combustion wali equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(l). Yeh 298 K aur 1 atm par zyada oxygen mein ek mole methane ka poora jalna hai; is ka ΔH°C manfi hai.

items: ΔH°C: ek mole substance ka zyada oxygen mein poora jalna; hamesha exothermic (ethanol –1368 kJ mol⁻¹); calorie content nikalne mein kaam aati hai.
